scope: Main workload characterization after accepted candidate hardware and all simdev pilot gates pass

blackscholes.input_correctness_reference: official per-option DGrefval; exact output checksum across execution modes
blackscholes.selection_reason: 4x the simdev pricing work with a finite target budget; official 4096-option simsmall is approximately 256x the pilot

streamcluster.input_class: project equivalent with official serial SimStream generator
streamcluster.selection_reason: 4x the simdev host distance-call count while retaining the official clustering kernel, RNG and iteration control

canneal.input_class: project swap-parameter scale on official simdev 100.nets
canneal.selection_reason: 4x simdev swaps on the same official 100-node netlist; project1k is approximately 20x and exceeds the per-run target budget

repeatability: After primary triplets, rerun one correction case per benchmark on the exact same ELF, simulator and input; compare target ROI cycles and output, while keeping repeats outside geomean selection.
scope_limits: Native is unprotected mode of the matched detection model without recovery datapath
no parallel scaling or full simsmall claim
